subject: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Brand <ethan.brand@skyline.health>
Cc: contracts@skyline.health
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk

Team,

Quick summary: over the last 18 hours we've seen sustained 500/502 rates on the inference fanout path for Skyline Health (see attached error_log_snippet.txt). This impacts the weekly export used in next week's QBR, and Skyline's data team flagged missing rows.

Immediate asks:
- Karthik/Vivek: can infra triage and propose a mitigation window today? We need a short-term rollback or routing policy change that keeps the QBR export intact.
- Marissa: please own customer comms and update Skyline's procurement thread with the impact + ETA.
- I'll escalate to execs if we can't provide a remediation timeline by EOD.

Attachments: error_log_snippet.txt, QBR_timeline.xlsx (light timeline with milestones).

Desired outcome by EOD: mitigation plan (owner, ETA, rollback option) and a comms draft for Skyline.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--
Note: attaching just the snippet here; full logs in the incident runbook link (internal).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 10:05:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk

On Tue, Feb 28, 2028 at 09:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team,
>
> Quick summary: over the last 18 hours we've seen sustained 500/502 rates...
>
Thanks for the heads-up. I can take lead on immediate mitigation. Initial notes:
- I'll spin up a targeted canary that routes Skyline traffic to the v2 model variant with degraded features but stable inference kernels. That should drop error rates quickly.
- Vivek, can you validate KV cache priming and any hot-shard throttles before we flip? I don't want to introduce cold-start regressions.
- I'll own the rollback path (will document checklist) and will post the checklist by 4pm PT.

Proposed meeting: 11:30am PT to sync infra + product owners (15m). If that works for Skyline, we can include them.

Karthik
Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Brand <ethan.brand@skyline.health>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@skyline.health
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 12:22:11 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the quick heads-up.

Skyline impact: the export missing rows affects our leadership deck and a regulatory snapshot. We need a mitigation that preserves data completeness; degraded model outputs are acceptable as long as row counts and schema are intact.

Two asks from our side:
1) If you do a canary, can you guarantee the export parity for the last 24 hours? If not, we need clear guidance on manual reconciliation.
2) Procurement is looped (contracts@skyline.health) — they'll need any change logs, especially if there are SLA implications.

We can join the 11:30am PT call.

—Ethan
Ethan Brand
Director, Data Operations
Skyline Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Brand <ethan.brand@skyline.health>
Cc: contracts@skyline.health
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 08:34:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk

Team — quick sync from my side after the triage discussion:

Actions agreed (owners / next steps):
- Karthik: prototype canary routing to v2 variant; document rollback checklist; target deliverable: 4pm PT today.
- Vivek: validate cache priming and monitor hot-shard metrics prior to flip; will post findings to the incident thread.
- Marissa: draft the customer comms (short impact note + ETA) and coordinate with contracts for any SLA notes.
- Vanessa (me): escalate to execs if we miss the 4pm checklist deliverable; will prepare a one-slide risk note for QBR.

Exec ask: if the canary is high-risk, we should prepare a contingency to pull the scheduled QBR export and run a manual reconciliation. Please surface the approx hours of engineering time required for that contingency.

Marissa — can you own comms and post a first draft by 1pm PT? Ethan — if the manual reconciliation becomes necessary we'll need a named Skyline owner for sign-off; can you confirm who that will be during the call?

Thanks —
Vanessa
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ethan Brand <ethan.brand@skyline.health>
Cc: contracts@skyline.health
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 16:04:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline exception handoff — QBR deliverables at risk

Vanessa / team — posting the comms + checklist as discussed. See attached: canary_rollback_checklist.docx.

Comms draft (to Skyline):
Hi Ethan —
Thanks for the patience. Summary: we will run a targeted canary routing Skyline traffic to a stable variant tonight at 00:30 PT; expected duration ~45 minutes. During the canary we expect parity of row counts; outputs may be slightly degraded in a small subset of records. If the canary fails, we will fall back to the pre-canary variant and execute a manual reconciliation to recover missing rows. Our reps will follow up with a short reconciliation plan and timing within 2 hours of rollback.

Next: please confirm your named approver for manual reconciliation (who will sign off on the reconciliation deliverable) and whether procurement needs a change-order for the rollback window.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: canary_rollback_checklist.docx (checklist includes: preflip validation queries, expected metrics baseline, rollback steps, post-run validation queries, and contact list).
